$comment: Module registry for scripts/module_context.mjs. roots own all files under them (longest prefix wins); tests list the directories/files that pin the module's contracts; layer follows contract < domain < app < adapters < ui vocabulary.

modules.role: Turn orchestration: session loop, streaming, approval persistence, recovery, run tracker, session-log authority
modules.notes: The durable-execution core. Approval/recovery/replay invariants here are pinned by the ownership map in packages/backend/README.md and protected by HARNESS_REVIEW.md.

modules.role: Agent loop and harness: Pi turn harnesses, step budget, compaction, tool resolution
modules.notes: No abstraction layer between AgentHarness and AgentRunner (AGENTS.md non-negotiable).

modules.role: Concrete tools: registry, schemas, file/shell/web/skill/awaiter/agent tools
Pre-turn assembly: context blocks, tool guard, prompt inputs
modules.notes: thread_session reaches turn_prep only via injected ports (depcruiser R5).

modules.role: Model supply: LLM factory, pi adapter, model discovery, tool model
modules.notes: Leaf module — must not reach up into tools/session/orchestration (depcruiser R1).

modules.role: File-backed persistence: collections, append-only session logs, row codecs
modules.notes: File store only: one JSON file per collection plus append-only JSONL session logs. The depcruise rules core-is-a-leaf and store-depends-only-on-core keep this package from reaching upward.

modules.role: Message codecs, ui/model conversions, system prompt assembly, markdown export
MCP server lifecycle, transports, remote tool registration
Continue-later wakes: awaiter manager, schedule, wake runs
Workspace and thread modes: scratch workspaces, worktrees, approval-policy parse
Shared foundation: guards, errors, config, types, logging, locale, http, aux-model runtimes
Top-level backend files (chat_platform, persona, logger) — catch-all below the named modules
modules.notes: Any file here that grows a real job should be promoted into a named module.

modules.role: Electron shell: IPC translate layer, windows, platform services. No business logic allowed.
Vue 3 SPA: components, composables, stores, chat module. electronAPI is the only backend door.
modules.notes: Imports only pure backend types/utils (depcruiser renderer-backend-whitelist). knip does not parse .vue — renderer surface is guarded by vue-tsc + eslint instead.

modules.role: Theme tokens, base46 compilation, theme editor logic
